# Fact: Fitness Routine

## Statement

Alex runs three times per week as the main form of exercise.

## Context

Alex's running schedule is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, typically in the morning.
The runs are between 5 and 10 kilometres in length.
Running is supplemented with occasional strength training on weekends.
The fitness routine supports the long-term goal of completing a marathon.
